dogecoin.text: Orchestrated pumps scare me. The pump almost never happens when they say it will. Whales are smart, they are rich for a reason..I’d rather see #dogecoin grow slow and steady. Be careful.

@MattWallace888 I like dogecoin. It’s made me a lot of money. But good investments will grow naturally because people believe in it. Organized rallies or pumps is not what doge needs. Slow and steady is the best way.

Don’t listen to everyone on YouTube or Twitter. None of us know when this bullrun is going to end. But don’t get greedy. Take your profits. Cause one day it will look like a healthy dip and it just won’t come back. #dogecoin #Bitcoin #cardano #xrp #Ethereum
